title: Sweet & Sour Sauce – Quick Takeout Style
description: Fast, tangy, sweet, and irresistibly familiar—your shortcut to classic Chinese takeout flavor at home.

method.instruction: Combine sugar, vinegar, ketchup, soy sauce, and pineapple juice in a saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer while stirring.
Mix cornstarch with water to make a slurry, then stir into the sauce until it thickens.
Cook 1 more minute, then cool slightly before serving.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Perfect with fried chicken, pork, or prawns. Also great as a dipping sauce for spring rolls.

notes.title: Quick Takeout Style
notes.content: Fast, sweet, and tangy—ready in 10 minutes, just like your favorite Chinese takeout.
